Describe the problem, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

Include package version/import, framework, browser/OS, language/theme/viewport, and a minimal reproduction. State whether this concerns shared UI, the optional workflow, or the example site.

List checks already run and relevant screenshots or public reproduction links. Remove credentials and personal data. For sensitive vulnerabilities follow SECURITY.md instead of posting details here.
